# zen-colors

> Perceptual CSS color tints, shades, scales, and contrast helpers (OKLCH by default).

Library: https://github.com/kematzy/zen-colors
Playground: this GitHub Pages site

## Package

```ts
import { Color, parse } from 'zen-colors'
new Color('#0af').tint(25).oklchString()
```

## Browser JSON (demo, client-side)

Open the playground API mode with query parameters. This is not a networked HTTP API;
it builds a JSON envelope in the browser for agents and copy/paste workflows.

Common query keys:
- op: parse | tint | shade | tints | shades | all | scale | contrast | fg | on | random
- c / color: CSS color string
- w / weight / step: number
- preset: zen | tailwind (scale only)
- against: contrast surface
- ratio: target for on()
- seed: optional for random

Example conceptual URL shape:
  ?mode=api&op=scale&c=%230af&w=10&preset=zen

## Defaults

- Mix space: OKLCH
- Playground canvas: all(weight), weight integer 2–25
- Export: zen tN/sN keys; optional Tailwind 50–950
